question: Can a lower scriptural teaching override a higher one?
premises: Teachings have successively higher levels of excellence.
A higher teaching overrides an earlier or lower one.
The Shaiva teaching is presented as higher in this hierarchy.
inference: Because higher teachings override lower ones, the Shaiva teaching cannot be overruled by Vaishnava statements.
uncertainties: The verse assumes a shared acceptance of the scriptural hierarchy it asserts.
plain_english: Because each higher teaching surpasses the earlier one and overrides it, the Shaiva teaching can never be overruled by Vaishnava statements.
